UPGRADE GUIDE

Storage form factors and interfaces

Decode M.2 2242, M.2 2280, SATA and PCIe NVMe.

Match the physical dimensions

M.2 2242 cards measure 22 by 42 mm. M.2 2280 cards measure 22 by 80 mm. Check the mounting point and hardware. For a 2.5-inch bay, check the required thickness as well.

Match the interface separately

M.2 describes the physical format. M.2 SSDs can use SATA or PCIe, and a laptop socket may support one or both. Confirm the drive protocol, slot, key and length in the laptop’s specifications. Some configurations need a specific carrier or adapter.
